correctness.rationale: Weighted PAVA finite active partitions and KKT show a continuous piecewise-linear map, with exact block Jacobians. Hölder computes norms and strict pooling KKT realizes every consecutive block locally; thus the global formula is exact. Coordinatewise endpoint maximization establishes the exact κ-envelope; one-variable differentiation establishes the unique dimension-free maximizer and its value, with p=1 and infinity proven separately. The embedded 5,252-check diagnostic independently corroborates formula identities and near-extremizers.

value.rationale: The exact sensitivity is relevant to reliability-weighted isotonic least squares, where errors are measured in ordinary observation norms despite weighted optimization. The theorem pinpoints which pooled intervals cause worst-case input amplification and completely optimizes amplification with weight contrast and dimension; it exposes a nonexpansivity rigidity threshold and endpoint discrepancy. The all-block realization and sharp κ-envelope are structural and not a mere rebranding of the known scalar Kantorovich factor.
